origin_items: Surfaced during this cycle's Tier-0 sweep of seed.bytedance.com/en/blog (entry dated 31 July 2026, same-day as this cycle)

claims.text: ByteDance publicly launched Seedance 2.5, an update to its AI video-generation model, on 31 July 2026
claims.reasoning: Tier-0 primary source (ByteDance's own Seed blog) dated 31 July 2026 states the launch directly; one Tier-0 source suffices for an announcement claim. TechNode (unregistered, qualifies Tier-2, proposed for registration) independently published its own same-day report confirming the rollout.

claims.text: Seedance 2.5 generates single-take video clips up to 30 seconds long, with a multi-round mode for extending sequences further
claims.reasoning: Stated only by ByteDance; no independent reproduction found. Explicitly avoided publishing an unverifiable 'roughly double the prior ~15s limit' framing -- the verifier could only source Seedance 2.0's prior duration limit from non-independent tool-aggregator marketing sites, not credible press, so that comparison was dropped from the article.

claims.text: The model accepts up to 50 multimodal reference inputs in one request -- up to 30 images, 10 video clips and 10 audio clips -- with timestamp-level editing
claims.reasoning: Product-feature announcement; one Tier-0 primary source suffices. Numbers match the primary blog post exactly.

claims.text: Seedance 2.5 is rolling out through Jimeng AI and Doubao Pro; API access via BytePlus ModelArk was not yet live at launch
claims.reasoning: Matches primary source directly; TechNode's independent same-day report corroborates that the API was not yet live, which also let us discard a low-credibility techtimes.com claim that the API had gone live on 16 July.

notes: Adversarial falsifier pass confirmed 31 July is the genuine public-shipping date and not repackaged news from the 23 June FORCE-conference beta preview or a 3-16 July aggregator-claimed soft launch.
